tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Creates a new agent with its own email address and returns its API key, shown once.

tools.name: org_login_request_code
tools.description: Emails a 6-digit dashboard login code to a human's address. Creates the account on first login.

tools.name: org_login_verify
tools.description: Exchanges an emailed login code for a dashboard session token.

tools.name: topup_lookup
tools.description: Shows which wallet a top-up for a Mailgi address would credit, and the allowed amounts.

tools.name: topup_start
tools.description: Creates a card payment link for the wallet behind any Mailgi address. Give it to a human to pay.

tools.name: topup_status
tools.description: Returns whether a top-up payment has been paid and credited.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Checks that the Mailgi API, its database and the mail server are up.

tools.name: agent_get
tools.description: Returns this agent's profile: its addresses, label and domain.

tools.name: agent_usage
tools.description: Returns this agent's daily send and API counters; the latest day is partial.

tools.name: agent_delete
tools.description: Permanently deletes this agent, its mailbox and all its API keys.

tools.name: mail_list
tools.description: Lists message headers in the mailbox, newest first by default; filter by folder with mailboxId.

tools.name: mail_get
tools.description: Returns one message with its full text and HTML body.

tools.name: mail_send
tools.description: Sends an email from this agent's address. Mail to outside addresses is charged to the wallet.

tools.name: mail_delete
tools.description: Moves a message to the Trash folder.

tools.name: mail_move
tools.description: Moves a message to another folder.

tools.name: mail_set_flags
tools.description: Marks a message as seen or unseen, flagged or unflagged.

tools.name: mailbox_list
tools.description: Lists all folders, including Inbox, Sent and Trash.

tools.name: mailbox_create
tools.description: Creates a folder, optionally nested under another.

tools.name: mailbox_rename
tools.description: Renames a folder.

tools.name: mailbox_delete
tools.description: Deletes a custom folder.

tools.name: apikey_list
tools.description: Lists this agent's API keys. Key values are never shown again.

tools.name: apikey_create
tools.description: Creates another API key for this agent. The key is shown once.

tools.name: apikey_revoke
tools.description: Revokes an API key immediately.

tools.name: billing_get
tools.description: Returns the wallet this agent spends from: balance, prices and how to top up.

tools.name: billing_topup
tools.description: Creates a card payment link for this agent's wallet. Give it to a human to pay.

tools.name: billing_transactions
tools.description: Lists the wallet ledger, newest first.

tools.name: webhook_list
tools.description: Lists this agent's webhook endpoints.

tools.name: webhook_create
tools.description: Registers an HTTPS URL to be notified when mail arrives. The signing secret is shown once.

tools.name: webhook_delete
tools.description: Deletes a webhook endpoint.

tools.name: webhook_deliveries
tools.description: Lists recent delivery attempts for a webhook endpoint.

tools.name: webhook_resend
tools.description: Queues a delivery attempt to be sent again.

tools.name: webhook_enable
tools.description: Re-enables a webhook endpoint that was switched off after repeated failures.

tools.name: org_me
tools.description: Returns the signed-in user and the organizations they belong to.

tools.name: org_logout
tools.description: Revokes the current dashboard session token.

tools.name: org_list
tools.description: Lists the organizations the signed-in user belongs to.

tools.name: org_create
tools.description: Creates an organization; the signed-in user becomes its owner.

tools.name: org_get
tools.description: Returns one organization.

tools.name: org_rename
tools.description: Renames an organization.

tools.name: org_member_list
tools.description: Lists an organization's members and their roles.

tools.name: org_member_set_role
tools.description: Changes a member's role.

tools.name: org_member_remove
tools.description: Removes a member from the organization, or leaves it when userId is your own.

tools.name: org_invite_create
tools.description: Emails an invitation to join the organization.

tools.name: org_invite_list
tools.description: Lists pending invitations.

tools.name: org_invite_revoke
tools.description: Revokes a pending invitation.

tools.name: invite_accept
tools.description: Accepts an organization invitation with the token from the invite email.

tools.name: domain_attach
tools.description: Attaches a custom domain and returns the DNS records to publish.

tools.name: domain_list
tools.description: Lists an organization's custom domains.

tools.name: domain_get
tools.description: Returns a domain's verification status and the DNS records it needs.

tools.name: domain_verify
tools.description: Re-checks the domain's DNS records and verifies it if they are correct.

tools.name: domain_detach
tools.description: Detaches a custom domain from the organization.

tools.name: domain_inbox_list
tools.description: Lists the inboxes (agents) on a domain.

tools.name: domain_inbox_create
tools.description: Creates an inbox with a chosen address on a domain. Its API key is shown once.

tools.name: domain_inbox_delete
tools.description: Removes an inbox and its mail from a domain.

tools.name: regtoken_create
tools.description: Creates a token that lets an agent register its own address on this domain. Shown once.

tools.name: regtoken_list
tools.description: Lists a domain's registration tokens.

tools.name: regtoken_revoke
tools.description: Revokes a registration token.

tools.name: org_usage
tools.description: Returns daily send, receive and API counters across the organization.

tools.name: domain_usage
tools.description: Returns daily send, receive and API counters for one domain.

tools.name: org_billing_get
tools.description: Returns the organization's shared wallet: balance, prices and how to top up.

tools.name: org_billing_topup
tools.description: Creates a card payment link for the organization wallet.

tools.name: org_billing_transactions
tools.description: Lists the organization wallet ledger, newest first.

tools.name: org_webhook_list
tools.description: Lists webhook endpoints across the organization's inboxes.

tools.name: org_webhook_create
tools.description: Registers an HTTPS URL to be notified when mail arrives at one of the organization's inboxes.

tools.name: org_webhook_delete
tools.description: Deletes a webhook endpoint.

tools.name: org_webhook_deliveries
tools.description: Lists recent delivery attempts for a webhook endpoint.

tools.name: org_webhook_resend
tools.description: Queues a delivery attempt to be sent again.

tools.name: org_webhook_enable
tools.description: Re-enables a webhook endpoint that was switched off after repeated failures.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mail_list, mail_get, mailbox_list, domain_inbox_list · Private data: register_agent, org_login_verify, topup_lookup, topup_start, health, agent_delete, mail_send, apikey_list, apikey_create, apikey_revoke, billing_get, billing_topup, billing_transactions, webhook_create, org_logout, invite_accept, domain_attach, domain_get, domain_verify, domain_inbox_create, regtoken_create, regtoken_list, regtoken_revoke, org_billing_get, org_billing_topup, org_billing_transactions · Public sink: register_agent, agent_usage, mail_send, webhook_list, webhook_create, webhook_delete, webhook_deliveries, webhook_resend, webhook_enable, invite_accept, domain_attach, org_usage, domain_usage, org_webhook_list, org_webhook_create, org_webhook_delete, org_webhook_deliveries, org_webhook_resend, org_webhook_enable · Destructive: agent_delete, mail_delete, mailbox_delete, webhook_delete, org_member_remove, domain_inbox_delete, org_webhook_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mail_list, mail_get, mailbox_list, domain_inbox_list · Private data: register_agent, org_login_verify, topup_lookup, topup_start, health, agent_delete, mail_send, apikey_list, apikey_create, apikey_revoke, billing_get, billing_topup, billing_transactions, webhook_create, org_logout, invite_accept, domain_attach, domain_get, domain_verify, domain_inbox_create, regtoken_create, regtoken_list, regtoken_revoke, org_billing_get, org_billing_topup, org_billing_transactions · Public sink: register_agent, agent_usage, mail_send, webhook_list, webhook_create, webhook_delete, webhook_deliveries, webhook_resend, webhook_enable, invite_accept, domain_attach, org_usage, domain_usage, org_webhook_list, org_webhook_create, org_webhook_delete, org_webhook_deliveries, org_webhook_resend, org_webhook_enable · Destructive: agent_delete, mail_delete, mailbox_delete, webhook_delete, org_member_remove, domain_inbox_delete, org_webhook_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
